scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && pnpm dev" --kill-others-on-fail
scripts.install:all: cd backend && go mod download && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.build:all: cd backend && go build && cd ../frontend && pnpm build
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && go run main.go" "cd frontend && pnpm start" --kill-others-on-fail
